_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the SFTP Storage Share egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: SFTP Storage Share
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A private file share reached over SFTP, with no game or app. Add subusers to share it, and give it as much disk as you need.
startup: echo "This server only stores files: connect over SFTP to reach them. It doesn't need to be running."; exec sleep infinity

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SFTP Storage Share: nothing to download. Files are uploaded over SFTP.
set -euo pipefail
echo "Nothing to install: connect over SFTP to store files. Subusers you add can reach them too."
